# @lacspace/env

> 标签: bytes, coercion, config, config-validation, dotenv, dotenv-expand, duration, env, env-example, env-schema, env-validation, envalid, environment, environment-variables, process-env, safe-parse, secret-redaction, t3-env, type-safe, typed-env, typescript, variable-expansion, zod-env

## 简介

Typed, validated environment variables — declare a schema, validate process.env at boot, get a typed frozen object or a clear fail-fast error. A zero-dependency t3-env / envalid alternative.
